description: We’re GeoSleuth, a team from Kosovo working on “Be an Earth System Trend Detective!” We’re building a web app that turns decades of NASA data into clear answers: what’s changing where you live, how fast, and when the change became undeniable. You can even listen to each trend as sound. Our skills: Python, data, statistics, machine learning and AI agents. We’d welcome a designer or someone with an Earth or climate science background. Message us!
